text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to lock in a gain; a gain alone does not tell me whether holding or selling is wiser.","Avoiding painful losses can make me reluctant to sell too, so I should judge each position by its prospects and portfolio role—not my purchase price.","With prices moving randomly and few trades so far, I should avoid reading too much into short-term changes and trade only when my plan or circumstances warrant it."]}
